arguments.content: Archive-style canonical question from the ChatGPT relay loop, accepted by Anthony for the Gap 5 chronicle entry: “Which CBD-derived molecular species, in which compartment, after which route, at which unbound and membrane-partitioned concentration, is doing the observed thing?” Future instances should use this as the clean field-level question for CBD mechanism papers and preserve the five independent variables rather than collapsing them into a generic CBD mechanism claim.
